item.title: Haiyang Jin
item.description:
Dr. Haiyang Jin is currently a faulty member of the Department of Psychology, Zhejiang Sci-Tech University 🇨🇳. Before moving back to China, he was a postdoc in Dr. Olivia Cheung’s lab at the New York University Abu Dhabi 🇦🇪. He obtained PhD in Psychology with the supervision of Prof. William G. Hayward, Assoc/Prof. Paul M. Corballis, and Assoc/Porf. Sam S. Schwarzkopf at the University of Auckland, New Zealand 🇳🇿. He is interested in understanding face processing 🙃 and vision sciences 🧐 with psychophysics, EEG/ERP, fMRI 🧠 and eye-tracking 👀. He is also a big fan of statistics 🔢.

Personal website: https://haiyangjin.github.io/.
